source_decisions.statement: Confirm L03 Binah target is exactly 139 curriculum slots under the existing Cycle 1 allocation.
Confirm current L03 evidence contains 8 language bindings and 0 recovered phrases.
Preserve current authority distribution as 3 FROZEN, 3 WATCH and 2 CANDIDATE unless separate evidence supports a later promotion.
Keep runtime activation false and HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE until explicit human-reviewed source transitions are approved.
Treat 'I usually...' as a semantic curriculum target only; do not infer any HNK translation or habitual/frequency grammar.
Keep all 139 L03 implementation slots MISSING at this gate; source review is not authoring.

governance_decisions.statement: No new HNK lexical form, particle, auxiliary, tense/aspect marker, word-order rule or discourse rule may be created by source lock.
WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN labels remain unchanged; binding does not equal promotion.
Reference languages remain comparative evidence only and cannot choose HNK forms or order.
Numerology constrains curriculum slot allocation only and cannot select language forms.
Do not generalize any scoped L01/L02 course grammar into universal HNK or into L03 without separate evidence.
If approved, prepare a separate L03 evidence/rebind review gate; do not author OPI, vocabulary or other L03 payload with the same approval.
